isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Cabo Verdean lexicon here. Each island variety is a separate dataset under this folder. Do not copy between islands. Do not insert Guinea-Bissau Kriol, Forro, Angolar, or Lung’Ie.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named island folder under dictionary/caboverde/. A merged Cabo Verdean lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each island sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Cabo Verdean island creoles. Lexicon is stored only in the island folders. APiCS 30, 31, and 32 were extracted into santiago/, brava/, and saovicente/. Other islands stay empty until a source names them.
